description: What the corpus holds and what it does not: laws, decisions, courts, the version archive and the Länder covered. Call it before you report that something does not exist. The answer's `coverage` block is /v1/coverage: statutes per Land (`statutes`: full_text, partial or none), decisions per court level, the citation graph and what every version date is, all from one daily table. Example: {}

court.description: Adds `courts` with only the courts whose name, slug or ECLI code contains this ('köln', 'BVerwG').

include.description: `["courts"]` adds `courts`: the court registry (slug, names, branch, level, Land, ECLI court code, decision count), at most 25 rows, busiest first.

name: getCoverage
title: Corpus coverage
